text: CoreWeave shares rose 23%. Its CEO reported demand at 10 times remaining 2027 capacity and multiple times 2028 capacity. Credit default swap spreads exceeded 11%, while asset-backed financing remained available. Customer prepayments and deposits totaled approximately $9 billion.

meta.note: Capacity demand ratios are management statements; asset-level borrowing rates of 7%-7.5% remain estimates.

text: The Wall Street Journal reported Nvidia's board was preparing to consider CEO Jensen Huang's removal. The New York Times reported a separate alleged relationship involving Nvidia executive Kimberly Powell. Shares fell over 9% after hours. An independent investigation remains active.

meta.note: Removal deliberations and the additional relationship remain reported allegations; no board decision is confirmed.
